topic: Vietnam's imports of mung and black gram beans (HS 0713.31) in 2023: tonnage and unit value
claim_a: Vietnam-reported: USD 138.3 million CIF and 103,835 t, USD 1.33 per kg; UN Comtrade flags the weight as estimated (FORM-08; SLP-14)
claim_b: Partner-reported exports to Vietnam: USD 86.1 million FOB and 129,380 t, USD 0.67 per kg (SLP-14); 2024: 185,470 t at USD 0.70; 2025: 167,108 t at USD 0.81
position_taken: Use partner-reported tonnage and unit values for prices and volumes, because Vietnam's weight is an estimate; keep Vietnam's value as the import bill. The value gap (USD 52 million) is larger than freight and insurance can explain and is not resolved
notes: Same pattern as BUY-01 notes for other HS lines (Vietnam weights flagged as estimated). Affects the raw-material cost of a mung bean isolate: USD 3.0 to 4.9 per kg of isolate on mirror prices, USD 6.0 to 8.1 on the Vietnam-reported value (our calculation, 60 to 80% recovery assumed)
